bound.walk: copy printed untemplated GET paths from the official MET Geosatellite swagger that have a last path segment; skip templated {format} paths and the root / image product; native ids are the last printed path segment; access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path; optional area/size/type/time query filters are not invented
bound.how: pda ingest --source geosatellite --limit 10. The official MET Geosatellite swagger prints 8 paths. The adapter copies the 5 untemplated GET paths that have a printed last segment (available, changelog, features, healthz, values). GET uses the printed /features collection with no invented query filters.

methods.why: Geosatellite /features prints feature datetime stamps and image ids (Mediterranean-Sea-IR-20260825220000, …). That is not a numeric time series with a year-like period field. methods/ was not edited.

notes: Ids are copied from printed swagger path last segments. access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path. No geosatellite id was written onto a met, nowcast, radar, oceanforecast, airquality, tidalwater, sunrise, spotwind, textforecast, icemap, ncagalewarnings, tafmetar, or datanorge row.
License is the printed swagger CC BY 4.0 URL http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0. Publisher is null: the spec prints contact.name Developer Support, not a publisher.
Original harvested swagger metadata stays in harvested_payloads. Fetch writes observations only. enrichments count stayed 0.

Nowcast stays --source nowcast. Metalerts stays --source met. Airqualityforecast stays --source airquality. Tidalwater stays --source tidalwater. Oceanforecast stays --source oceanforecast. Sunrise stays --source sunrise. Radar stays --source radar. Spotwind stays --source spotwind. Textforecast stays --source textforecast. Icemap stays --source icemap. NCAgalewarnings stays --source ncagalewarnings. Tafmetar stays --source tafmetar after PR 109. Lane B Subseasonal stays PR 110. This source does not re-implement those.
